source_title: United Arab Emirates Film Production Crew Rate Basket Survey
source_authority: Regional Production Benchmark / Neutral Floor
supported_proposition: Standardized basket of key BTL technician rates (Gaffer, Key Grip, 1st AC, Sound Mixer, Production Coordinator) indexed against Los Angeles baseline 1.00.
derivation_methodology: Comparative analysis of published union rate cards, guild recommendations, and audited production payroll samples normalized to USD at reference FX.
limitations: Individual commercial rates vary based on tier, shoot duration, and crew scarcity in peak production season.

source_title: United Arab Emirates Statutory Employer Payroll Burden Schedule
source_authority: UAE Ministry of Human Resources & Emiratisation (MOHRE)
supported_proposition: UAE Federal Labour Law No. 33 of 2021 Article 51: Expatriate End of Service Gratuity (EOSG 21 days/yr = 5.75%)
derivation_methodology: Sum of mandatory statutory employer contributions: social security, pension, health insurance, unemployment, and workers compensation.
limitations: Excludes employee income tax withholdings; statutory ceilings and wage caps apply depending on individual earner brackets.

source_title: Jurisdiction Labour Code / Film Commission Regulatory Framework
source_authority: National Ministry of Labour
supported_proposition: No collective bargaining agreement or guild fringe surcharge mandated; crew engaged on individual commercial contracts under statutory regime.

limitations: Commercial service agreements govern terms without separate institutional fringe markups.

source_title: Entertainment Payroll House Standard Commercial Tariff

supported_proposition: Third-party employer-of-record, statutory processing, and tax compliance service fee averaging 3.5% - 4.5% of gross payroll.

limitations: Subject to volume discounts and package bundling with accounting software suites.

source_title: United Arab Emirates Camera & Lighting Rental Supply Market
source_authority: ARRI Rental / Panavision / Keslow Camera / MBS Equipment Co
supported_proposition: Commercial camera, grip, and electric package pricing operates strictly on bespoke production quotations; nominal reference index is 0.70.
derivation_methodology: Rental packages are heavily discounted (up to 60-80% off list) based on project scale, camera package exclusivity, and multi-week commitments.
limitations: Public rate cards do not reflect commercial deal points; production must supply bid package.

supported_proposition: Employees' Provident Fund (EPF 12.0%) + Employees' State Insurance (ESI 3.25%)
derivation_methodology: Sum of mandatory statutory employer contributions: social security, pension, health insurance, unemployment, and workers compensation.
limitations: Excludes employee income tax withholdings; statutory ceilings and wage caps apply depending on individual earner brackets.

source_title: Jurisdiction Labour Code / Film Commission Regulatory Framework
source_authority: National Ministry of Labour
supported_proposition: No collective bargaining agreement or guild fringe surcharge mandated; crew engaged on individual commercial contracts under statutory regime.
derivation_methodology: Institutional collective agreement terms negotiated between producer associations and film technician unions.
limitations: Commercial service agreements govern terms without separate institutional fringe markups.

source_title: Entertainment Payroll House Standard Commercial Tariff
source_authority: Entertainment Partners / Cast & Crew / Sargent-Disc / Moneypenny
supported_proposition: Third-party employer-of-record, statutory processing, and tax compliance service fee averaging 3.5% - 4.5% of gross payroll.
derivation_methodology: Standard commercial enterprise master service agreement schedules for theatrical film production.
limitations: Subject to volume discounts and package bundling with accounting software suites.

source_title: India Camera & Lighting Rental Supply Market
source_authority: ARRI Rental / Panavision / Keslow Camera / MBS Equipment Co
supported_proposition: Commercial camera, grip, and electric package pricing operates strictly on bespoke production quotations; nominal reference index is 0.80.
derivation_methodology: Rental packages are heavily discounted (up to 60-80% off list) based on project scale, camera package exclusivity, and multi-week commitments.
limitations: Public rate cards do not reflect commercial deal points; production must supply bid package.

source_title: India Soundstage & Studio Facilities Benchmark
source_authority: Major Studio Stage Operators (Pinewood, Shepperton, Babelsberg, Cinecittà, Trilith, Korda)
supported_proposition: Soundstage and mill space leasing requires bespoke facility availability agreements; nominal reference index is 0.75.
derivation_methodology: Facility agreements bundle stage floor area, annex offices, backlots, power grid consumption, and prep/strike windows into negotiated terms.
limitations: Strictly subject to global occupancy cycles and tenancy commitments.

source_title: India Production Transport & Grip Van Survey
source_authority: Production Vehicle Rental Fleet Providers / Enterprise Fleet
supported_proposition: Standard production cargo van / 15-passenger crew van daily rental rate including basic commercial insurance is approximately $95/day.
derivation_methodology: Market quotes from commercial fleet suppliers across production centers.
limitations: Fuel, driver wages, overtime, and toll surcharges are billed separately.

source_title: ATA Carnet & Customs Clearance Fee Structure
source_authority: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) / US Council for International Business (USCIB)
supported_proposition: Cross-border temporary admission of professional equipment via ATA Carnet and customs broker clearance averages 1.50% of equipment value.
derivation_methodology: Published ATA Carnet basic fee tiers, surety bond percentages, and customs clearance charges.
limitations: Air/sea cargo shipping freight tariffs depend on total volumetric weight.

source_title: India Foreign Entertainer / Technical Work Authorization Fee
source_authority: National Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Immigration
supported_proposition: Temporary film production work visa filing and consular endorsement fee averages $250 USD per imported specialist.
derivation_methodology: Survey of diplomatic visa schedules for temporary professional engagements.
limitations: Expedited processing fees and legal representation are additional.

source_title: India Production Legal & Production Accounting Index
source_authority: Local Production Legal Counsel / Chartered Production Accountants
supported_proposition: Local production legal retainer, incentive qualification audit, and chartered production accounting fees index at 0.75 relative to LA baseline.
derivation_methodology: Audited production accountant rates and media law firm retainer averages.
limitations: Complex multi-party co-productions require expanded legal representation.

source_title: India Production Catering & Craft Service Standard
source_authority: Production Catering Contractors / Film Guild Guidelines
supported_proposition: Hot breakfast, hot lunch, and continuous craft service per crew member per shoot day is $25/day.
derivation_methodology: Standard commercial catering bid packages across film production centers.
limitations: Dietary specializations and remote location kitchen travel surcharges apply.

source_title: India Film Commission Local Labour Mandate / Guidelines

supported_proposition: Local production legal retainer, incentive qualification audit, and chartered production accounting fees index at 0.90 relative to LA baseline.
derivation_methodology: Audited production accountant rates and media law firm retainer averages.
limitations: Complex multi-party co-productions require expanded legal representation.

source_title: Manitoba Production Catering & Craft Service Standard
source_authority: Production Catering Contractors / Film Guild Guidelines
supported_proposition: Hot breakfast, hot lunch, and continuous craft service per crew member per shoot day is $48/day.
derivation_methodology: Standard commercial catering bid packages across film production centers.
limitations: Dietary specializations and remote location kitchen travel surcharges apply.

source_title: Manitoba Film Commission Local Labour Mandate / Guidelines
source_authority: National/Provincial Film Commission & Incentive Authority
supported_proposition: Provincial tax credit guidelines (e.g. BC PSTC / ON OFTTC) require Canadian / provincial resident BTL labor to maximize eligible labor spend; minimum economic target is 70-75%.
derivation_methodology: Statutory cultural test requirements and qualifying expenditure guidelines.
limitations: Reflects regulatory and incentive requirements; actual crew composition depends on local infrastructure availability.

source_title: Manitoba Production Schedule & Contingency Risk Factor
source_authority: Completion Guarantor Standard Practice (Film Finances / First Australian / Media Guarantors)
supported_proposition: Infrastructure maturity, weather volatility, and vendor availability yield a schedule risk multiplier of 1.00 (1.00 = LA baseline).
derivation_methodology: Actuarial completion guarantor bond underwriting standards.
limitations: Severe exterior location weather dependencies require project-specific insurance endorsements.

source_title: New Brunswick Film Production Crew Rate Basket Survey
source_authority: Regional Production Benchmark / Neutral Floor
supported_proposition: Standardized basket of key BTL technician rates (Gaffer, Key Grip, 1st AC, Sound Mixer, Production Coordinator) indexed against Los Angeles baseline 1.00.
derivation_methodology: Comparative analysis of published union rate cards, guild recommendations, and audited production payroll samples normalized to USD at reference FX.
limitations: Individual commercial rates vary based on tier, shoot duration, and crew scarcity in peak production season.

source_title: New Brunswick Statutory Employer Payroll Burden Schedule
source_authority: WorkSafeNB
supported_proposition: Canada CPP/EI (8.23%) + WorkSafeNB (2.22%)
derivation_methodology: Sum of mandatory statutory employer contributions: social security, pension, health insurance, unemployment, and workers compensation.
limitations: Excludes employee income tax withholdings; statutory ceilings and wage caps apply depending on individual earner brackets.

source_authority: BCCFU (IATSE 891, Teamsters 155, DGC BC) & IATSE 873

limitations: Public rate cards do not reflect commercial deal points; production must supply bid package.

limitations: Strictly subject to global occupancy cycles and tenancy commitments.

supported_proposition: Contractual union fringes: Active Health, Pension, Defined Contribution, Retiree Health, Industry Funds totaling 18.5% - 21.0% on gross scale wages.
derivation_methodology: Institutional collective agreement terms negotiated between producer associations and film technician unions.
limitations: Applies strictly to signatory productions. Non-union productions incur 0% union fringe.

source_title: Entertainment Payroll House Standard Commercial Tariff
source_authority: Entertainment Partners / Cast & Crew / Sargent-Disc / Moneypenny
supported_proposition: Third-party employer-of-record, statutory processing, and tax compliance service fee averaging 3.5% - 4.5% of gross payroll.
derivation_methodology: Standard commercial enterprise master service agreement schedules for theatrical film production.
limitations: Subject to volume discounts and package bundling with accounting software suites.

source_title: South Carolina Camera & Lighting Rental Supply Market
source_authority: ARRI Rental / Panavision / Keslow Camera / MBS Equipment Co
supported_proposition: Commercial camera, grip, and electric package pricing operates strictly on bespoke production quotations; nominal reference index is 1.00.
derivation_methodology: Rental packages are heavily discounted (up to 60-80% off list) based on project scale, camera package exclusivity, and multi-week commitments.
limitations: Public rate cards do not reflect commercial deal points; production must supply bid package.

source_title: South Carolina Soundstage & Studio Facilities Benchmark
source_authority: Major Studio Stage Operators (Pinewood, Shepperton, Babelsberg, Cinecittà, Trilith, Korda)
supported_proposition: Soundstage and mill space leasing requires bespoke facility availability agreements; nominal reference index is 1.00.
derivation_methodology: Facility agreements bundle stage floor area, annex offices, backlots, power grid consumption, and prep/strike windows into negotiated terms.
limitations: Strictly subject to global occupancy cycles and tenancy commitments.

source_title: South Carolina Production Transport & Grip Van Survey
source_authority: Production Vehicle Rental Fleet Providers / Enterprise Fleet
supported_proposition: Standard production cargo van / 15-passenger crew van daily rental rate including basic commercial insurance is approximately $180/day.
derivation_methodology: Market quotes from commercial fleet suppliers across production centers.
limitations: Fuel, driver wages, overtime, and toll surcharges are billed separately.

source_title: US Interstate Commerce Exemption
source_authority: US Customs and Border Protection
supported_proposition: Domestic US interstate transport incurs zero customs, duties, or ATA Carnet documentation bonds.
derivation_methodology: Interstate shipments within the United States customs territory are exempt from customs processing.
limitations: Domestic freight trucking costs apply but are classified under domestic transport.

source_title: US Domestic Employment Freedom of Movement
source_authority: USCIS / US Department of Labor
supported_proposition: US domestic production incurs zero visa or work permit fees for US citizen/resident personnel.

limitations: Importing foreign ATL/BTL crew requires O-1/P-1 petitions with USCIS filing fees.

source_title: South Carolina Production Legal & Production Accounting Index

limitations: Complex multi-party co-productions require expanded legal representation.
